Results.ReviewText: Had a much smaller Weber gas grill that gave up the ghost after many years of use. Bought this larger one and I truly feel like I am driving a Cadillac. The propane gas system is very smooth and the grill heats up to 500 degrees in 5 minutes. So far I've cooked steaks on it twice and they came out great. After cooking I left the 3 burners on high for another 5 minutes (the temp reached 600) and everything brushed off easy. Very pleased with my purchase.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This grill is smaller than I was used to, but it is big enough for any conceivable needs we would have. It is so brilliantly designed that I cannot think of a way to improve it. Yes, it's that good. It also may be the simplest grill I have ever seen. But the bottom line is that it heats quickly and accurately, which makes perfect grilling an expectation. The design also makes it easy to clean, and the warranty makes this a no-brainer. This is the finest grill I have ever used. Period.
Results.Title: Finest Grill I Have Ever Used

Results.Title: Weber-the best BBQ Pit available!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is our 8th Weber BBQ grill in over 50 years.  We started out with a Smokey Joe when we were first together and several years later upgraded to the larger kettle BBQ. Some years after that we purchased our first Weber gas grill and have stayed with gas ever since purchasing 4 more BBQ’s including two Q 1000’s for camping in our RV.  We had one Genesis grill for over 9 years when I noticed the burners weren’t burning evenly even after I cleaned them.  I called the company to get a replacement model number and the person asked if I had registered the grill when I bought it.  I told her I didn’t remember so she checked for me and told me I had registered the product and she would have new burners sent out the next day free of charge!  That was the only problem we ever encountered with a Weber grill over the years which is amazing because we live in CA and grill probably an average of 3 days a week year round. Our grills have definitely had heavy usage.  We’ve moved into a smaller home recently so we decided to downsize to the Spirit 3 burner grill.  It takes up less space and with the larger wheels it’s easier to move around the backyard.  I’ve been totally impressed with the design and functionality of the grill. I also appreciate how Weber has maintained their basic design but continues to improve their products over the years.  Another testament to the longevity of the Weber grills is that 6 of our old grills found new homes with friends or family members when we upgraded to the next model.  When I’m ready for a new grill I always look at other BBQ’s to see if there’s anything I like better but after doing the research I always end up with a Weber!
Results.Title: Lifelong Weber Owner

Results.Title: Wonderful

Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
